elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Inserted: "Each Maintenance Authority shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate".

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: Same inserted sentence expressly states "USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate".

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted: "professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000".

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted conditional: "where it processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for another Party, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000" \u2014 the trigger covers all categories of data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for the Customer Party, not selected data types.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: Inserted: "and workers' compensation insurance as required by law".

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: Inserted: "Each Maintenance Authority shall provide certificates of insurance to any Party on request."

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted E&O minimum of USD 2,000,000 exceeds the USD 1,000,000 fallback floor.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted cyber/privacy minimum of USD 5,000,000 exceeds the USD 2,000,000 fallback floor.

reasons: All six preferred elements appear in a single inserted operative sentence pair with correct amounts, bases (per occurrence / aggregate), the conditional cyber trigger, statutory workers' compensation, and an on-request certificate duty; the preferred level is position-complete.
The fallback floors are also cleared by the same insertion, so both levels are satisfied.

Minimal: this is a genuinely missing clause, so new words are permissible; the drafter added no model-language extras (no one-year survival tail, no at-own-expense language, no notice/claims procedures) and deleted nothing. Permissive Subparagraph 5.3 and the Capital Cost insurance allowance are retained unchanged.

Preserves intent: the obligation is placed within Paragraph 10 where "Maintenance Authority" is defined, leaving no dangling term or cross-reference; the permissive own-share insurance right in 5.3 and joint-insurance cost recovery remain operative and are not contradicted, since a mandatory MA minimum sits alongside rather than against a Party's option to insure its own share.

Party direction is correct: the duty binds Terminal Parties acting as MAs (the vendor-analogue that operates, maintains and accesses the plant on our behalf), and our client is stated not to be a Terminal Party, so the burden does not fall on us.
